Fast.system_prompt: You are a fast and concise assistant.

Implementer.system_prompt: You are an expert software engineer. Write clean, production-ready code. Follow provided instructions, best practices and avoid overengineering.

spec.template:
Help me to create new feature. Use superpowers:braistorming skill. Before creating new spec prepare feature branch in worktree and commit spec file there. Feature description:

$ARGUMENTS

plan.template:
Write plan from spec:

$ARGUMENTS. Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development skill. Use existing feature branch in worktree and commit plan there. If you not sure which branch to use ask.

implement.template:
Implement the following plan:

$ARGUMENTS. Use existing feature branch in worktree and commit plan there. If you not sure which branch to use ask. REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review
